patch_list: The "watch a video" buttons pay out instantly. Tap one and you get the cash, repair or ticket reward without any ad or wait.
Everything in the shop is free. Tap any item — coins, tickets, VIP, remove-ads, car packs or bundles — and it is granted immediately, with no Google Play payment screen and nothing charged.
Removes full-screen and banner ads. Rewarded "watch a video" buttons keep working.
Unlocks the VIP Club subscription automatically on every launch. No payment screen, no Google Play subscription, nothing charged.
